name: RNA strand
oneLine: A chain of letters that can store a message and also do work.
howItWorks: RNA is a single chain of nucleotides. The order of letters is the message. The chain can also fold into shapes that act like tools.
deeper: The idea that RNA did both jobs before DNA and proteins existed is called the RNA world. It is the leading hypothesis for early life, not a proven story.
realSize: a few to tens of nm long
sizeComparison: a 10,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Strands here are stiffer and shorter than real ones.
